pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Atlas is a schema-as-code tool for managing database schemas with declarative HCL or SQL migrations, drift detection, and CI/CD integration.
This package installs Ariga's default prebuilt "atlas" binary: the proprietary build (OSS plus closed-source code, licensed under Ariga's Master License and Services Agreement) that is not buildable from the public ariga/atlas GitHub repository. It is a superset of dev-db/atlas-bin (the Apache-2.0 Community Edition, also a prebuilt binary): it adds advanced migration commands, migration/schema linting, declarative "schema plan"/"schema validate" workflows, drift detection, Atlas Registry integration, and drivers for SQL Server, ClickHouse, Redshift, and other engines beyond MySQL/PostgreSQL/SQLite/MariaDB. Some of those features additionally require an "atlas login" session against a paid Atlas Cloud subscription (Pro/Enterprise); this package only provides the local CLI binary, not a subscription.
Named after its license (there is no crisp official one-word name for this edition upstream) to disambiguate it from dev-db/atlas-bin, which now means "Community Edition, prebuilt" to match the usual Gentoo foo/foo-bin convention.

use.flag: Install Ariga's "extended" binary variant instead of the default one. This is a local overlay convenience flag, not a Gentoo policy convention: it swaps which upstream-prebuilt binary is fetched, adding beta database drivers (Oracle, Snowflake, Spanner, Databricks) on top of the default binary's feature set, at the cost of a substantially larger download. Same Atlas-MSA-20260701 license either way.
